scope: TensorRT VideoMAE-base app gate on Jetson Orin ARM64 (TRT 10.16.2); promotes the TRT cell of `Video classification (videomae)` from RUNTIME-PASS to P. Requires the neuriplo-infer video-classification output fix (same branch): per-window top-1 logging, last-window render save, labels-file name resolution. P covers this model + environment only.

build.commit: a246fb80330bed70d0bc3c8fcc8e77774d717938 + uncommitted video-classification output fix (app/src/CLICommands.cpp, app/src/ResultRenderer.cpp, app/inc/ResultRenderer.hpp)

gate.checked: log inspected: window ending frame 15 gives grooming dog (0.151), training dog (0.134), walking the dog (0.083) — dog-related top-3 on a dog-subject clip, semantically valid; stable across windows (frame 16 repeats the same top-2). Render shows 5 ranked bands (this OpenCV-free build draws bands without text by design). Valid run_report.json with per-stage timings.
